title: Purple Velvet Top & Leg Warmers
prompt: An original young woman with long, wavy honey-blonde hair stands full-length against a black backdrop with her arms crossed. She wears a fitted purple velvet long-sleeve top, layered silver chains with a round pendant, and a patterned mini skirt with a sage waistband. Purple knit leg warmers and lace-up ankle boots complete the look. A patterned scarf hangs from one side. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, focused studio light. Palette of orchid, sage, and deep black. Playful and vintage, in the style of a 1990s grunge lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The velvet top and patterned leg warmers are the textures to keep.
- Add 'full-length, head to toe' to keep the boots in frame.
tryThis: Try this: Use head-to-toe framing to include the boots.
